chunk-001:c001.proposition: Well-being includes both mitigating suffering and realizing the positive possibilities available to conscious beings.

chunk-001:c002.proposition: Moral questions have objectively right and wrong answers that can be progressively discovered by investigating the variables affecting human value and flourishing.

chunk-001:c006.proposition: The overarching danger in religious and secular totalitarian systems is evidence-resistant dogmatism, because it prevents conversational correction of bad ideas and requires coercive enforcement.

chunk-001:c008.proposition: Transformative spiritual experiences can be genuine features of consciousness, but any truths they disclose must transcend the culturally contingent dogmas attached to them.

chunk-001:c010.proposition: Religious texts contain harmful injunctions capable of directing ordinary believers toward cruelty and constraining modern ethics within obsolete doctrine.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-05.proposition: Sophisticated metaphorical theology becomes increasingly unconstrained by scripture and can project preferred psychological insights onto almost any text.

chunk-003:c003-07.proposition: Redefining God as an abstract relation to truth or the unseen changes the traditional term without establishing the personal supernatural being ordinarily asserted by believers.

chunk-003:c003-09.proposition: Incompatible Christian, Hindu, and Buddhist moral narratives show that the usefulness of religious heuristics cannot establish any one tradition as the deeper truth.

chunk-004:chunk-004-candidate-05.proposition: Ambiguous religious language can validate unsupported beliefs by failing to distinguish an abstract account of God from the Bible's supernatural and barbaric claims.

chunk-004:chunk-004-candidate-09.proposition: A worldview continuously corrected through honest engagement with reality is preferable to one anchored to unchanging ideas created without modern tools or knowledge.
